successCriteria.description: The `LeaveType` type exposes exactly six values — `annual`, `sick`, `emergency`, `unpaid`, `maternity`, `paternity` — all lowercase, and no other values are assignable to the type.
The `LeaveRequestStatus` type exposes exactly five values — `DRAFT`, `SUBMITTED`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `CANCELLED` — all UPPERCASE, and no other values are assignable to the type.

`src/shared/types/index.ts` re-exports both `LeaveType` and `LeaveRequestStatus` (the type and the value) so that downstream consumers can `import { LeaveType, LeaveRequestStatus } from 'src/shared/types'`.
`tsc --noEmit` passes with zero errors when the shared-types module is the only new code present (no type errors from the enum definitions or barrel export).
Jest unit tests in `tests/unit/shared/types/` verify every enum value is present and correctly typed, and `npx jest --passWithNoTests` exits zero.

constraints: The enum implementation must use the const-object + union-type pattern (`const X = { ... } as const; type X = (typeof X)[keyof typeof X]`), not TypeScript `enum` keyword — this aligns with the project's preference for simple constructs and avoids numeric-enum pitfalls.
Files must reside at the exact paths declared by the reconciled architecture: `src/shared/types/leave-type.enum.ts`, `src/shared/types/leave-request-status.enum.ts`, `src/shared/types/index.ts`.
No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards if needed (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`).
Tests must live under `tests/unit/shared/types/` matching the Jest `testMatch` pattern `**/tests/**/*.test.(ts|js)`.
outOfScope: Database tables, migrations, or any persistence concern — this phase is pure TypeScript types with zero runtime dependencies.

Any domain logic, validation, or business rules involving these enums (e.g., lifecycle state-machine enforcement, balance deduction rules) — those belong to later phases (leave service, balance service).

entityInvariants.invariant: LeaveType is an immutable, closed set of six string literal values: `annual`, `sick`, `emergency`, `unpaid`, `maternity`, `paternity`. No value may be added, removed, or renamed without a migration plan for all downstream consumers (policy, balance, leave modules).

LeaveRequestStatus is an immutable, closed set of five string literal values: `DRAFT`, `SUBMITTED`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `CANCELLED`. The lifecycle is: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → (APPROVED | REJECTED); any non-terminal state → CANCELLED. No value may be added, removed, or renamed without a migration plan for all downstream consumers.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `LeaveType` values must match the reconciled architecture's domain entity definition exactly: `'annual' | 'sick' | 'emergency' | 'unpaid' | 'maternity' | 'paternity'`.
The `LeaveRequestStatus` values must match the reconciled architecture's domain entity definition exactly: `'DRAFT' | 'SUBMITTED' | 'APPROVED' | 'REJECTED' | 'CANCELLED'`.

The barrel export at `src/shared/types/index.ts` must re-export both the runtime const object and the derived type for each enum, matching the pattern used by existing module barrel exports in the project.
